correctness.rationale: Composition mod t⁶ gives the coefficient pair (A,B)=(a(a²+b),b(a²+b)), with the last two input coordinates free. The degree-4/5 subgroup is central and additive; the squares from a=0 generate its vertical axis and those from a=1 give every first coordinate. For A≠0 setting u=a²+b makes the fibers exactly q² times the number of rational roots of u³+Bu+A², with inverse formulas a=A/u, b=u+a². The derivative test excludes multiple roots. The distinct rational-root triples are {r,s,r+s}, yielding (q−1)(q−2)/6 such targets; there are (q−1)² target-root incidences, giving q(q−1)/2 one-root targets and (q²−1)/3 unattainable ones. On A=0 the identity has q³ roots and each B≠0 has q² by bijectivity of Frobenius. Truncation to N≤3 annihilates squares, and at N=4 a=1 gives every possible fourth coefficient. At q=2 the candidate 3q² is numerically distinct but occurs zero times, as the table says. The frozen script and recorded exhaustive outputs at q=2,4,8,16 corroborate only those cases; the uploaded script was not executed.
